description: AutoCAD audit checks, one or more per mistake of references/practice/mistakes-autocad.md (ids keep the mistake id as their first part: ac-001.*). Facts tables and new evaluators are specified in FACTS.md.

checks.title: No geometry or annotation on layer 0 in model or paper space
checks.why: Content on layer 0 has no layer control, and layer-0 content in an xref'd drawing takes the host's insert layer and cannot be managed.

fix.note: Set setLayer to the standard layer for the object type before running.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-001 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S48 S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Block definition contents are not in the entities table, so blocks built on 0 are not reported

checks.title: Nothing on Defpoints except what AutoCAD puts there
checks.why: Defpoints never plots, so content on it is silently missing from prints.

fix.note: Set setLayer to the correct layer; non-plotting content belongs on a no-plot layer such as A-ANNO-NPLT.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-002 (detection: Auto); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Dimension definition points live inside dimension blocks and are not entities, so they are never reported

checks.title: Colour is ByLayer on every entity in model and paper space
checks.why: Hard-coded properties stop consultants fading an xref'd drawing through its layers, and layer edits no longer propagate.

fix.note: Sets every entity in the drawing to ByLayer for this property; check that each layer has the right value first.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-003 (detection: Auto); sources S48 S32 S33 S40, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Contents of block definitions may be ByBlock and are not checked here; see ac-006

checks.title: Linetype is ByLayer on every entity in model and paper space
checks.why: Hard-coded properties stop consultants fading an xref'd drawing through its layers, and layer edits no longer propagate.

fix.note: Sets every entity in the drawing to ByLayer for this property; check that each layer has the right value first.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-003 (detection: Auto); sources S48 S32 S33 S40, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Contents of block definitions may be ByBlock and are not checked here; see ac-006

checks.title: Lineweight is ByLayer on every entity in model and paper space
checks.why: Hard-coded properties stop consultants fading an xref'd drawing through its layers, and layer edits no longer propagate.

fix.note: Sets every entity in the drawing to ByLayer for this property; check that each layer has the right value first.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-003 (detection: Auto); sources S48 S32 S33 S40, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Contents of block definitions may be ByBlock and are not checked here; see ac-006

checks.title: Dimensions are on a dimension layer
checks.why: Dimensions on other layers cannot be frozen, filtered or plotted as a group.

fix.note: Set setLayer to the discipline's dimension layer (patterns.dimensionLayer in the standard).

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-004 (detection: Heur); sources S48 S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Automatic for the object-type-to-layer rule of patterns.dimensionLayer; other wrong-layer cases need review

checks.title: No text on wall layers
checks.why: Text on a wall layer disappears when walls are frozen and plots at the wall weight.

fix.note: Set setLayer to the discipline's text layer.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-004 (detection: Heur); sources S48 S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Layer names follow the project's layer naming scheme
checks.why: Recipients filter, freeze and translate layers by name; a layer outside the scheme is lost on exchange.

fix.note: Put each finding's value (the old layer name) into map with its target layer, ask the user to confirm, then run.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-005 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S41, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Block definitions have no hard-coded colour, linetype or lineweight
checks.why: Entities with fixed properties inside a block ignore the layer the block is inserted on, so the block cannot be faded or recoloured with its layer.

fix.instructions: Edit the block: put its entities on layer 0 with colour, linetype and lineweight ByBlock (or ByLayer), then redefine it; keep deliberate multi-layer blocks on their own layers but ByLayer.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-006 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S33 S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Entities on non-0 layers with ByLayer properties are allowed because deliberate multi-layer blocks exist; their count is in the blocks table for review

checks.title: Doors, windows and other repeated items are block instances, not loose lines
checks.why: Exploded blocks lose counts, attributes and central updates, and bloat the file.

params.instructions: Look for repeated identical line clusters and loose door-swing arcs on door layers; replace them with block instances of the standard blocks.

fix.instructions: Look for repeated identical line clusters and loose door-swing arcs on door layers; replace them with block instances of the standard blocks.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-007 (detection: Heur); sources S33 S41 S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. No reliable automatic signal

checks.title: Dimensions are dimension objects, not exploded lines and text
checks.why: Exploded dimensions no longer measure the geometry and cannot be updated.

params.instructions: Look for lines, solids and text on dimension layers forming arrow-plus-text patterns; redimension with dimension objects.

fix.instructions: Look for lines, solids and text on dimension layers forming arrow-plus-text patterns; redimension with dimension objects.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-008 (detection: Heur); sources S33 S40, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No dimension text replaces the measured value
checks.why: An overridden value hides a geometry error and misleads the builder.

fix.instructions: Remove the override so the dimension shows <>; if the value was wrong, the geometry is wrong: ask before changing the design.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-009 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S33 S40 S53, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Empty overrides, overrides that keep <> (e.g. '<> TYP') and EQ are accepted

checks.title: Geometry is drawn at true size, not fudged
checks.why: Lengths a fraction off round values make dimensions that do not add up.

params.instructions: Measure key lengths: values within a small epsilon of round values but not equal, or dimensions needing more than 1/4 in precision; ask the designer before correcting.

fix.instructions: Measure key lengths: values within a small epsilon of round values but not equal, or dimensions needing more than 1/4 in precision; ask the designer before correcting.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-010 (detection: Heur); sources S48 S42, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Round values depend on design intent

checks.title: Dimension styles in use display no finer than a buildable precision
checks.why: Precision finer than can be built implies a tolerance nobody can achieve.

fix.instructions: Set DIMDEC (and DIMRND) so the style shows 1/4 in or 1/2 in (imperial) or whole millimetres (metric); see dimensions-annotation.md section 4.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-011 (detection: Auto); sources S49 S42, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Thresholds: 1/4 in [S49][S48], 1 mm

checks.title: Drawing insertion units are set to the project unit
checks.why: Blocks and xrefs are scaled on insert by the ratio of insertion units; unset or wrong units bring content in at the wrong size.

fix.note: Sets INSUNITS only. Check existing inserts for wrong scale before and after; scaleContents true is a design change to approve first.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-012 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S52 R04, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Text styles the standard marks annotative are annotative in the drawing
checks.why: Non-annotative styles force text to be duplicated per scale, which goes wrong when scales change.

fix.note: Updates the drawing's styles from the standard; existing non-annotative text keeps its height and must be checked.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-013 (detection: Heur); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Automatic for the style part; duplicated text per scale needs review

checks.title: Text is not duplicated per scale on separate layers
checks.why: Copies of the same note at several heights go out of step when one is edited.

params.instructions: Look for the same string at several heights close together, often on per-scale layers; convert to annotative text with the needed scales.

fix.instructions: Look for the same string at several heights close together, often on per-scale layers; convert to annotative text with the needed scales.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-013 (detection: Heur); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Text plots at a standard height for its scale
checks.why: Odd text heights are inconsistent and can fall below the legible size when plotted.

fix.instructions: Set the height to the standard plotted height times the scale factor (drawing-conventions.md section 4), or make the text annotative.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-014 (detection: Auto); sources S10 S14, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Viewports are locked
checks.why: An unlocked viewport changes scale with one scroll, unnoticed.

fix.instructions: Check the viewport scale, then lock the display (MVIEW Lock On).

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-015 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S33 S41, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Xrefs are inserted on the designated xref layer
checks.why: An xref lands on the current layer and vanishes when that layer is frozen.

fix.note: Set setLayer to the layer in the standard's codeList xrefLayers (G-ANNO-REFR in the US preset).

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-016 (detection: Auto); sources S48 S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Xrefs use relative paths
checks.why: Full paths break as soon as the project folder moves or is sent.

fix.note: Makes every reference relative where the file is on the same drive; references across drives or servers stay full and must be reported.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-017 (detection: Auto); sources S54 S32 S41, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Every xref resolves to a file
checks.why: A missing reference leaves content out of the drawing and out of every plot.

fix.note: Add the folders to search; references that cannot be found are reported to the user, never removed.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-017 (detection: Auto); sources S54 S32 S41, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Directly referenced xrefs that contain references are overlays
checks.why: An attached xref carries its own references into every host, which duplicates or loops nested content.

fix.instructions: Change the reference type to Overlay in the External References palette unless the host must carry the reference when it is itself xref'd.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-018 (detection: Heur); sources S54 S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Attach can be intended; a human confirms

checks.title: Drawings with references are sent as a package with a transmittal
checks.why: A drawing sent without its references, fonts and plot styles is incomplete at the recipient.

params.instructions: Process item: confirm the issue was packaged with eTransmit (or the project's tool) and a transmittal record exists.

fix.instructions: Process item: confirm the issue was packaged with eTransmit (or the project's tool) and a transmittal record exists.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-019 (detection: Proc); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Nothing is left to purge at issue
checks.why: Unused blocks, layers, styles and registered applications bloat the file and clutter every list.

fix.note: Destructive: list what will be purged and get the user's approval first.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-020 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S09 S10 S43 R04, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Counts one purge pass including registered applications

checks.title: Received and outgoing files have been audited
checks.why: Latent database errors propagate through every file that references or copies the damaged one.

params.instructions: Run AUDIT without fixing on a copy and read the error count; fix and RECOVER if needed (cad-standards.md section 9).

fix.instructions: Run AUDIT without fixing on a copy and read the error count; fix and RECOVER if needed (cad-standards.md section 9).

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-021 (detection: Heur); sources S43, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Kept manual: auditing is an operation on the database, not a fact the collector reads

checks.title: No duplicate lines
checks.why: Coincident duplicates double plot weight, inflate quantities and confuse edits.

fix.instructions: Delete the duplicates listed (OVERKILL removes them in bulk) after confirming with the user.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-022 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S41 S42, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Exact coincident LINEs in any layer; partial collinear overlaps and other entity types need OVERKILL review

checks.title: Hatches are associative
checks.why: A non-associative hatch does not follow its boundary when the drawing changes.

fix.instructions: Re-hatch with associativity on, picking the boundary.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-023 (detection: Auto); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Exploded hatches (many small lines) need review

checks.title: Patterns expected to change are associative arrays
checks.why: Copies at a regular spacing cannot be edited as a pattern later.

params.instructions: Look for repeated identical objects at regular spacing; rebuild as an associative array if edits are expected.

fix.instructions: Look for repeated identical objects at regular spacing; rebuild as an associative array if edits are expected.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-024 (detection: Heur); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Dimension styles in use are the standard's dimension styles
checks.why: Many ad hoc dimension styles give inconsistent output.

fix.instructions: Move dimensions to the standard style, then purge the unused style.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-025 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S41 S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Style counts above a project limit have no sourced figure; unused styles are reported by ac-020

checks.title: Text styles in use are the standard's text styles
checks.why: Many ad hoc text styles give inconsistent output.

fix.instructions: Move text to the standard style, then purge the unused style.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-025 (detection: Auto); sources S32 S41 S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Endpoints meet exactly; no stacked vertices
checks.why: Near-miss endpoints and stacked vertices break joins, hatches and areas.

params.instructions: Look for vertices within a tiny tolerance of each other and endpoints near but not on other geometry; snap them together.

fix.instructions: Look for vertices within a tiny tolerance of each other and endpoints near but not on other geometry; snap them together.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-026 (detection: Heur); sources S32 S42, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: 2D entities lie flat at Z = 0
checks.why: Stray Z values and tilted extrusions make snaps, hatches and areas wrong.
checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-027 (detection: Auto); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. 3D solids, surfaces and meshes are skipped by the collector

checks.title: Polylines on area layers are closed
checks.why: An open boundary gives a wrong or impossible area.

fix.instructions: Close the boundary (PEDIT Close) after checking that the closing segment follows the room outline.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-028 (detection: Auto); sources S42 S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No junk from pasted foreign content
checks.why: Pasting from other versions or software brings foreign styles, anonymous blocks and huge scale lists.

params.instructions: Look for unknown style and layer names, many anonymous blocks and an inflated annotation scale list; purge, translate layers and reset the scale list.

fix.instructions: Look for unknown style and layer names, many anonymous blocks and an inflated annotation scale list; purge, translate layers and reset the scale list.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-029 (detection: Heur); sources S32, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Text styles in use use an approved font
checks.why: SHX and custom fonts make PDFs unsearchable and go missing at the recipient.

fix.note: Remaps the standard's styles; styles not in the standard are moved by hand.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-030 (detection: Auto); sources S33 S41, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Polylines have zero width outside annotation layers
checks.why: Polyline width ignores the plot style and prints inconsistently.

fix.instructions: Set the polyline width to 0 and let the layer lineweight give the weight.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-031 (detection: Auto); sources S40, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. 'Non-graphic layers' read as layers outside patterns.widthAllowedLayer

checks.title: Title block data is in attributes of the standard title block
checks.why: Typed text in place of attributes cannot be filled or updated across sheets.

params.instructions: Open each layout: title block values must be attributes of the title block insert; reinsert the standard title block and transfer values.

fix.instructions: Open each layout: title block values must be attributes of the title block insert; reinsert the standard title block and transfer values.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-032 (detection: Heur); sources S40 S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No loose text on the title block layer in paper space
checks.why: Loose text on the title block layer usually means the title block was exploded or typed over.

fix.instructions: Reinsert the standard attributed title block and transfer the values into its attributes.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-032 (detection: Heur); sources S40 S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Lines meant to be orthogonal are exactly orthogonal
checks.why: Lines a fraction of a degree off axis make joins and dimensions misbehave.

fix.instructions: Rotate or redraw the line to the exact angle.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-033 (detection: Auto); sources S40 S48, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Deviation measured from the WCS axes; a deliberately rotated plan should be drawn in a rotated UCS and reviewed

checks.title: Model-space dimensions use a linear scale factor of 1
checks.why: A DIMLFAC other than 1 makes a dimension show a value that is not the geometry, which fakes a scale.

fix.instructions: Draw at 1:1 and set DIMLFAC to 1; if the geometry is not at true size, scale it with the user's approval.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-034 (detection: Heur); sources S33 S10 S14, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Automatic for the DIMLFAC signal; implausible extents need review

checks.title: Model space is drawn at 1:1
checks.why: Geometry not at true size makes every dimension and scale wrong.

params.instructions: Compare dimension measurements and overall extents with known sizes (a door, a grid bay); report implausible values.

fix.instructions: Compare dimension measurements and overall extents with known sizes (a door, a grid bay); report implausible values.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-034 (detection: Heur); sources S33 S10 S14, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Plotted layers use colours in the plot-style colour map
checks.why: With colour-dependent plot styles colour is the lineweight; a colour outside the map plots at the wrong weight.

fix.instructions: Recolour the layer to a colour of the project's plot-style map (codeList plotColours) that gives the intended weight.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-035 (detection: Auto); sources S09, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Layers only; entity colour overrides are reported by ac-003.color-bylayer

checks.title: Viewport scales are approved scales
checks.why: A drawing at a non-standard scale (1:1328.4) cannot be scaled or measured.

fix.instructions: Set an approved scale from the standard, then re-check annotation and lock the viewport.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-036 (detection: Auto); sources S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Image frames do not plot
checks.why: Plotted image frames print as boxes around every raster image.

fix.instructions: Set IMAGEFRAME to 2 (shown, not plotted) or 0.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-037 (detection: Auto); sources S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Xrefs are nested no more than one level deep
checks.why: Deep reference chains are fragile and slow to load.

fix.instructions: Reference each source drawing directly in the host and overlay it, instead of through another xref.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-038 (detection: Auto); sources S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: The drawing has fewer than 20 layouts
checks.why: A master DWG with many layouts that everyone pastes into loses traceability.

fix.instructions: Propose splitting into referenced drawings on a shared origin; do not do it unasked.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-039 (detection: Heur); sources S88, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. The 20-layout figure comes from one practitioner thread; content far from the origin needs review

checks.title: The drawing is not a single master file with content far from the origin
checks.why: Content pasted in at random positions cannot be referenced on a shared origin.

params.instructions: Check drawing extents against the agreed project origin and whether disciplines paste into one file.

fix.instructions: Check drawing extents against the agreed project origin and whether disciplines paste into one file.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-039 (detection: Heur); sources S88, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: No splines on layers for built work
checks.why: Splines cannot be set out on site and give odd dimensions.

fix.instructions: Replace the spline with arcs and lines that can be set out.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-040 (detection: Auto); sources S42, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. 'Construction layers' read as layers outside patterns.splineAllowedLayer (landscape, survey, topography, planting, annotation)

checks.title: Repeated content is a block or an xref, not a copy
checks.why: Copies of the same content drift out of sync.

params.instructions: Look for identical geometry repeated across files and multi-discipline sheets with no xrefs; propose blocks or xrefs.

fix.instructions: Look for identical geometry repeated across files and multi-discipline sheets with no xrefs; propose blocks or xrefs.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-041 (detection: Heur); sources S42, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Needs several files; no single-drawing signal

checks.title: Layers are named by content, not by line weight
checks.why: Layers named THIN or THICK cannot be frozen by building system and are useless to anyone who xrefs the drawing.

fix.note: Map each finding's layer to content layers of the standard; a weight layer usually splits into several.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-042 (detection: Heur); sources S48, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: The drawing is saved with a paper-space layout current
checks.why: A drawing saved in model space opens where the recipient cannot plot it as issued.

fix.instructions: Make the main layout current and save.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-043 (detection: Heur); sources S09, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Folder structure for relative xref paths is covered by ac-017

checks.title: Every layout has at least one viewport
checks.why: Empty or leftover layouts leave doubt about which sheets are live.

fix.instructions: Delete the layout with the user's approval, or set it up as a sheet.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-044 (detection: Auto); sources S88 S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Layouts missing from the sheet list are not detected (sheet set data is outside the DWG)

checks.title: Real-size hatch patterns are at scale 1
checks.why: Brick and block patterns are drawn at real size; scaling them makes the coursing wrong.

fix.instructions: Reset the pattern scale to 1, unless the pattern file is in the other unit system (an inch acad.pat pattern in a millimetre drawing needs 25.4).

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-045 (detection: Heur); sources S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. A scale of 25.4 or 1/25.4 is right when the pattern file and drawing units differ

checks.title: Model-space linetype scaling (MSLTSCALE) is the project value
checks.why: Inconsistent linetype scaling makes dashed lines look solid or vary between scales.

fix.note: For the Illinois State method change equals in the project's copy of this check.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-046 (detection: Auto); sources S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Paper-space linetype scaling (PSLTSCALE) is the project value
checks.why: Inconsistent linetype scaling makes dashed lines look solid or vary between viewports.

fix.note: For the Illinois State method (PSLTSCALE 0) change equals to 0 in the project's copy of this check.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-046 (detection: Auto); sources S10, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Default expects the paper-space method of cad-standards.md section 6

checks.title: Viewports use the sheet well: inside the drawable area, no large blank areas
checks.why: Crowded or half-empty sheets read badly and break set conventions.

params.instructions: Check each layout: viewports inside the title block's drawable area, clear of the title strip, plans in the same position across sheets (sheets-sets.md section 5).

fix.instructions: Check each layout: viewports inside the title block's drawable area, clear of the title strip, plans in the same position across sheets (sheets-sets.md section 5).

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-047 (detection: Heur); sources S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md

checks.title: Plotted layers in use do not all share one lineweight
checks.why: Without a lineweight hierarchy cut, projection and pattern read the same and the drawing is flat.

fix.instructions: Apply the standard's layer lineweights (layer.ensure with update true) or the project's plot style; see drawing-conventions.md section 2.

checks.source: mistakes-autocad.md AC-048 (detection: Auto); sources S44, see references/practice/_SOURCES.md. Covers the all-layers-equal case; a plot style that maps every colour to one width is not visible in the DWG and needs review
